Question: What is AWS Service Agent? Answer: An AI-powered AWS security auditing/operations agent. Stack: Python, Scapy, TensorFlow Lite, React.js, Socket.IO. The public GitHub README describes an agentic AWS security auditing tool that scans an AWS environment for misconfigurations and security risks. It combines deterministic rule-based checks with AI-powered analysis via Amazon Bedrock. The current public README says EC2 and S3 scanners are live, with IAM, VPC, RDS, Lambda, CloudTrail and KMS planned. The backend uses FastAPI and boto3. The frontend uses Next.js 15 and Tailwind CSS. The Bedrock layer returns structured JSON findings and is instructed to report only findings supported by scan evidence. The current GitHub README lists GLM 4.7 Flash via Amazon Bedrock as the AI model. The README says the project can scan S3 public access blocks, ACLs, bucket policy public status, versioning and encryption, and EC2 instance state, public IP exposure, instance type, region, launch time and tags.
